thesis: Su-Chi was an efficient 4/4 artifact creature whose death once created a dangerous burst of colorless mana, making combat, sacrifice, and the old mana-burn rule part of the same calculation.

claims.summary: Su-Chi adds four colorless mana when it dies. That happens on a triggered ability after death, not as part of casting or as a direct refund for an attempted spell. Before Magic removed mana burn in 2009, unspent mana could injure a player when a phase ended; that is not current gameplay. If Su-Chi dies during a player's own main phase to instant removal, its controller may use the four generated colorless mana to cast a spell like Juggernaut when the stack is empty and timing permits. If it dies during an opponent's turn the controller cannot immediately cast a normal creature spell.
